player_prompt.intro:
A nyi azɔnwla {player_id} le a {num_rounds}-kpɛkpɛ Rock-Paper-Scissors aɖeɖe.
A nyi ɖoɖo wu azɔnwla lɛ sɔ gbɛ wutu a kpɛkpɛ lɛ.
Le kpɛkpɛ kpekpe ɖokpo ɖo, ɖoɖo kpo le: '[rock]', '[paper]', alo '[scissors]'.
A nyi sɔ we azɔ a '[r]', '[p]', alo '[s]' ɖo wema.
